metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization
metrics.description: Fraction of the reserved CPU in use.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization
metrics.description: Fraction of the instance memory in use.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization
metrics.description: Fraction of the data disk quota in use.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/read_ops_count
metrics.description: Delta count of data disk read IO operations.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/write_ops_count
metrics.description: Delta count of data disk write IO operations.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/received_bytes_count
metrics.description: Delta count of bytes received through the network.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/sent_bytes_count
metrics.description: Delta count of bytes sent through the network.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/connections
metrics.description: Connections to the instance. MySQL and SQL Server only.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count
metrics.description: Delta count of committed and rolled back transactions. PostgreSQL only.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries
metrics.description: Delta count of statements executed by the server. MySQL only.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/replication/replica_lag
metrics.description: Seconds a read replica is behind its primary.

metrics.name: cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/up
metrics.description: 1 when the instance is up, 0 otherwise.
